names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 mai, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Mochie».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Μώκιος ο Ιερομάρτυρας», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 11 May, „Свештеномученик Мокије.“ — one rank word, which is the `hieromartyr` this folder already carries in `types` and `honorific.js` composes back, and one forename. The heading gives no epithet, no city and no year: Rome, Amphipolis, Macedonia, Diocletian, the idol of Dionysus and the 295 are all in the body. A direct walk of every `names` entry in `saints/` finds no folder holding Мокије, so the form folds with nothing — neither `mocius-of-emesa` nor `michaeus-of-zographou`, the two the name sweep raised for this folder once before, has a Serbian form.

The heading of the calendar’s name link 1578, «Мокий Амфипольский, сщмч.», with the rank abbreviation left off. The day’s own line gives only «Сщмч. Мокия (ок. 295)», without the city. `fk.mjs` returned NONE before the write.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Мокия (ок. 295).»

attestations.note: The identification is exact and not a name match: the calendar’s life makes him presbyter at Amphipolis in Macedonia under Diocletian, the man who broke the idol of Dionysus with the Name of Jesus Christ, came unharmed out of the furnace that burned the governor Лаодикий, was unhurt by the lions, and was sent by way of Perinthus to Byzantium and beheaded there — the same man the Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows of this folder already keep on 11 May, and the name link heads him «Мокий Амфипольский, сщмч.» with the city the folder’s own slug carries. `dates` is unchanged: the folder holds «288 or 295» and the Russian line and life both give «около 295 года», which that interval contains. The life page lists no day but this one. What the Russian adds and the paragraph now carries: the feast of Dionysus he preached against, the governor’s name, the furnace, the lions, the crowd that demanded his release, his last words «Господи, приими в мире дух мой», and the church the emperor Константин afterwards built for him and moved his relics into. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 mai — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Mochie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Μώκιος ο Ιερομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and the page for the dedication of Constantinople on this same day says why the day matters twice over: «Η συγκεκριμένη ημέρα της τελέσεως των εγκαινίων της Κωνσταντινουπόλεως επιλέχθηκε σκόπιμα, γιατί συνέπιπτε με την ημέρα της μνήμης του μαρτυρίου του Αγίου Μωκίου, ο οποίος ήταν και ο πολιούχος του Βυζαντίου» — the day of the dedication was chosen on purpose because it fell on the day of Mocius's martyrdom, he being the patron of Byzantium. **He is not `mocius-of-emesa`** or `michaeus-of-zographou`, the name sweep's other two rows. **`dates` are added where the folder had none**, as a death in 288. **The Greek adds what the folder lacked**: his parents Euphratius and Eustathia at Rome under Diocletian; his schooling in the sacred letters and his ordination; the see of Amphipolis in Thrace, which is the epithet the corpus's slug already carries; the prefect Laodicius who tortured him and the prefect Maximus who flayed him and threw him to the beasts and saw him come out alive; the sending bound to Byzantium in 288 and the beheading there; Constantine the Great's building of a magnificent church in his honour and the laying of his relics in it; the imperial procession to that church at Mid-Pentecost; and that the relic of Samson the Hospitable was kept there too. **`related` is not extended to `samson-the-hospitable`**: a relic kept in the same church is not an association between two men, on the rule that a dedication is not a relation. **One hymn is added**, the apolytikion, which is proper and names him. **The relics are in the note and not in `locations`**: fragments at the monasteries of Saint Dionysius and of Panteleimon on the Holy Mountain.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 24.05.2026 (11. мај ст. ст.) — „Свештеномученик Мокије.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry, five sentences long, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek both keep him on, so nothing moved. **A DEATH WIDENED AND NEITHER YEAR CHOSEN**: „Посечен за Христа 295. године“ against saint.gr's «Τότε, το έτος 288 μ.Χ. τον έστειλε δέσμιο στο Βυζάντιο, όπου τον αποκεφάλισαν» and its head line «(; - 288)», so `death` is now 288–295 and reads „288 or 295“. `node .tmp/dd.mjs "288 or 295"` reads it in both packs. **Both books date the same event, the beheading**, and they are seven years apart, so this is the two-books-disagree widening the coordinator's ruling allows and not a narrowing. **A SECOND DISAGREEMENT, ABOUT THE PROVINCE, RECORDED AND NOT SETTLED**: this book makes Amphipolis „граду македонском“, a Macedonian city, where saint.gr gives «την Αμφίπολη της Θράκης», Amphipolis of Thrace — and the slug and display name of this folder carry the city and not the province, so nothing had to move. Both stand in the life. **New here**: that he was a Roman by birth, which saint.gr gave only as his parents being at Rome; and **that by prayer he shattered the idol of the god Dionysus, which embittered some of the heathen against him and brought others to the faith** — a wonder in no other book read for this folder. **This book has no Byzantium in it at all**: the prefects Laodicius and Maximus, the flaying, the beasts, the sending bound to the capital and the patronage of the city are the Greek page's and are not repeated as this book's. `types` untouched: Свештеномученик is the `hieromartyr` the folder carries and „свештеник“ the `presbyter`. **No `locations`**: Amphipolis is now named by three books and two provinces, which is a reason not to put a point on it. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţa răbdând până la sânge Sfinţite Mucenice Mochie, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Sfințit Mucenic Mochie», Glasul 4

english.text: Sharing in the ways of the apostles and successor to their thrones, thou didst find in action, O God-inspired one, a path to the contemplation of things on high. Therefore, rightly teaching the word of truth and keeping the faith even unto blood, O hieromartyr Mocius, entreat Christ God to save our souls.

hymns.text: Χριστῷ ἱερουργῶν, ἱερεὺς ὢν τῆς δόξης, θυσίαν λογικήν, καὶ ὁλόκληρον θῦμα, ἀθλήσεως ἄνθραξι, σεαυτὸν προαενήνοχας, ὅθεν Μώκιε, διπλῶ στεφάνω σὲ στέφει, ὁ δοξάσας σε, ὡς δοξασθεῖς σοῦ τοὶς ἄθλοις, Χριστὸς ὁ φιλάνθρωπος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, Χορὸς Ἀγγελικός, the only hymn on the page of «Άγιος Μώκιος ο Ιερομάρτυρας»

english.text: Ministering as a priest to Christ, being a priest of the glory, thou didst offer thyself as a reasonable sacrifice and a whole burnt offering upon the coals of thy contest; wherefore, O Mocius, he who glorified thee crowns thee with a double crown, being himself glorified in thy contests — Christ the lover of mankind.

hymns.text: И нравом причастник,/ и престолом наместник апостолом быв,/ деяние обрел еси, Богодухновенне,/ в видения восход;/ сего ради, слово истины исправляя,/ и веры ради пострадал еси даже до крове,/ священномучениче Мокие./ Моли Христа Бога/ спастися душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 мая ст. ст., «Тропарь священномученика Мокия», глас 4 — the common of a hieromartyr with his name set into it

english.text: Partaker of their way of life and successor to the thrones of the apostles, O divinely inspired one, thou didst find in action an ascent to contemplation; wherefore, rightly ordering the word of truth, thou didst suffer for the faith even unto blood, O hieromartyr Mocius. Pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Вооружився щитом веры,/ нечестивых ополчения стерл еси, священномучениче,/ и венец от Христа взял еси, Мокие,/ тем и, со Ангелы радуяся, спасай от бед поющия тя,/ моля непрестанно о всех нас.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 мая ст. ст., «Кондак священномученика Мокия», глас 8 — proper to him, and it names him

english.text: Armed with the shield of faith, thou didst wipe out the hosts of the impious, O hieromartyr, and didst receive a crown from Christ, O Mocius. Therefore, rejoicing with the angels, save from troubles those who hymn thee, praying without ceasing for us all.

death.note: Two books seven years apart on the same event, the beheading, and neither chosen. saint.gr: «Τότε, το έτος 288 μ.Χ. τον έστειλε δέσμιο στο Βυζάντιο, όπου τον αποκεφάλισαν», with the head line «(; - 288)»; the Ohrid Prologue, for the Julian 11 May: „Посечен за Христа 295. године.“ The Prologue names no place for it, where the Greek puts it at Byzantium. Neither page gives a year for his birth; the Greek has his parents at Rome under Diocletian, «(επί Διοκλητιανού 284 - 304 μ.Χ.)», and the Prologue has him suffer „за време Диоклецијана“ with no numbers.
